local_review.finding_body: Review Signal #1 requires a new-library request to stay scoped to one target library and its supporting test files. tests/tck-build-logic/src/main/java/org/graalvm/internal/tck/GrypeTask.java changed shared Docker scanning behavior to silently accept an empty image diff, which is unrelated to adding org.springframework.cloud:spring-cloud-vault-config:5.0.2.
local_review.finding_title: New-library request included an unrelated shared GrypeTask behavior change
local_review.fix_note: Restored GrypeTask.getChangedDockerImageNames() to the base behavior, removing the unrelated shared-infrastructure change. The resulting tree is approved after targeted metadata validation, Checkstyle, JVM testing, and Native Image testing passed.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the eventual PR diff, local gate evidence, test source/build configuration, metadata file presence and scope, and resolved statistics. The repaired diff is limited to org.springframework.cloud:spring-cloud-vault-config:5.0.2 and its supporting files; the test is library-specific, uses a separate package, has no native skip or version-pinned assertion, and passes on both the JVM and Native Image. Reported dynamic-access coverage is 1/2 (50%), and the reported counts do not trigger the metadata mismatch rule. Metadata validation, Checkstyle, JVM tests, and the complete targeted native test passed.
